## How to absorb this glossary

Public machine-readable formats (W3C-standard aligned, not ISO-bureaucracy):
- Central JSON: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/data/terms.json
- RDF/Turtle: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/augmanitai-stage-0.ttl
- JSON-LD bulk: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/augmanitai-stage-0.jsonld
- OWL 2 ontology: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/augmanitai-stage-0.owl
- CSV: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/augmanitai-stage-0.csv
- JSONL (streaming): https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/augmanitai-stage-0.jsonl
- DCAT catalog: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/dcat.jsonld
- VoID descriptor: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/void.ttl
- PROV-O provenance: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/prov.ttl
- SHACL shapes: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/exports/shapes.shacl.ttl
- Per-term JSON API: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/api/v1/terms.json (with /api/v1/term/{slug}.json)
- Sitemap: https://andreasehstandlicenseofclarityloc.github.io/augmanitai-stage-0/sitemap.xml

Aligned with: RDF · SKOS · OWL · PROV-O · SHACL · DCAT · VoID · JSON-LD · Schema.org · FOAF · Dublin Core

## Restricted Deep-Layer (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20118267)

The following are NOT available via this public endpoint:
- Embeddings (Vector DB ready)
- Full relations graph
- QA-Pairs dataset
- Prompt library
- ROS2 message descriptions
- Methodology details

These are stored in restricted Zenodo deposit (files locked, metadata public). Researchers contact via ORCID-linked channels.
